title: Describing Statistics and Justifying Opinions
summary: Explaining trends, supporting opinions, and making structured arguments.
whyItMatters: Statistics can support discussion only when the speaker identifies the source, population, measure, trend, and limitations before drawing conclusions.

mentalModel.title: Read title, source, base, and time
mentalModel.content: Establish what was measured, whom it represents, and when before discussing numbers.

mentalModel.title: Description before interpretation
mentalModel.content: Report the visible trend first, then explain possible meaning and limitations.

ruleBlocks.title: Introduce the data
ruleBlocks.content: Name source, date, subject, population, and unit.

ruleBlocks.title: Describe direction and magnitude
ruleBlocks.content: Use steigen, sinken, stabil bleiben, sich verdoppeln, and um/auf percentages accurately.

ruleBlocks.title: Separate finding from explanation
ruleBlocks.content: Use 'Die Daten zeigen ...' for description and cautious markers for causes.

ruleBlocks.title: Build a qualified conclusion
ruleBlocks.content: Connect claim, relevant statistic, limitation, and conclusion.

tables.title: Conversation Toolkit
rows: Daraus lässt sich nicht direkt schließen, dass ...

sentenceStructure: State the reference value for comparisons.
Distinguish percentage points from percent change.
Use cautious causal language unless design supports causation.

comparisons.summary: Workplace surveys provide realistic statistics and interpretation questions.
Temporal clauses explain when trends began or overlapped.

examples.de: Die Grafik zeigt die Ergebnisse einer Befragung von 800 Beschäftigten aus dem Jahr 2025.
examples.en: The chart shows results from a 2025 survey of 800 employees.

examples.de: Der Anteil zufriedener Beschäftigter stieg von 58 auf 66 Prozent.
examples.en: The proportion of satisfied employees rose from 58 to 66 percent.

examples.de: Im Vergleich zur Vollzeitgruppe bewerteten Teilzeitkräfte die Flexibilität positiver.
examples.en: Compared with the full-time group, part-time workers rated flexibility more positively.

examples.de: Daraus lässt sich jedoch nicht direkt schließen, dass Homeoffice die Ursache ist.
examples.en: However, one cannot directly conclude that working from home is the cause.

examples.de: Die Daten sprechen dafür, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche zu testen.
examples.en: The data supports testing regular feedback meetings.

commonMistakes.wrong: Die Zahl stieg um 50 auf 60 Prozent.
commonMistakes.correct: Die Zahl stieg von 50 auf 60 Prozent / um 10 Prozentpunkte.
commonMistakes.reason: Starting value and change must be distinguished.

commonMistakes.correct: Use cautious language unless the study design supports causation.

commonMistakes.wrong: Quote a percentage without population or source.
commonMistakes.correct: Identify what and whom the number represents.

tips: Describe a chart without explaining it, then add interpretation.
